name: MegaSystem
description: Uruguayan online store for phone repair parts (screens, batteries, charging boards), tools and phone accessories, with physical stores. Ships across Uruguay by transport agency.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de repuestos para celulares (pantallas, baterías, placas de carga), herramientas y accesorios, con locales físicos. Envía a todo Uruguay por agencia de transporte.

ships_to.notes: Home page FAQ says it ships to all of Uruguay with agencies such as Correo Uruguayo and DAC; free shipping on purchases over 3,000 pesos.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Physical stores are listed in Montevideo, Las Piedras and Paysandu; the locations page does not describe online-order pickup.

shopping_notes: Catalog is mostly repair parts, tools and supplies for phones, aimed at repair shops as well as consumers. Shipping cost depends on agency and locality.

sources.supports: Home page FAQ: shipping to all of Uruguay via Correo Uruguayo, DAC or agency of choice; free shipping threshold
